title: Finding Support & Help in The Admin Area | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Finding Support & Help in The Admin Area Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000006845 Search for solutions easily in the Admin Account Dashboard. Support & Help The " Support & Help " is found at the bottom of the Admin Dashboard, next to the Website Resources. Support Documents Browse help articles and guides: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions Create Support Ticket Report a problem or ask a question: How to Submit a Support Ticket Join the Facebook Group Connect with the BD Community: http://facebook.com/groups/BrilliantDirectories/ Help Center Additionally access direct assistance by clicking on the help icon, " HELP CENTER ", that appears on most of the Admin pages: Here articles and videos relevant to the page will appear as well as a search bar to search for additional topics within that section of the Admin: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
